name: leave_ja
title: 休暇の申請
description: 有給休暇・病気休暇・特別休暇の申請。上長が承認し、5 営業日を超えるときは部長も承認する（架空の決まり）。有給休暇は、休暇の帳簿が持つ残りから日数を引く

items.name: kind
items.text:
種類(kind) : choice "休暇の種類"
有給(paid) "有給休暇"
病気(sick) "病気休暇"
特別(special) "特別休暇"

items.name: first_day
items.text: 初日(first_day) : date "初日" range >=2026-01-01 <=2027-12-31 open in 本社

items.name: days
items.text: 日数(days) : number "営業日の日数" range >=1 <=20

items.name: back_on
items.text: 復帰日(back_on) : date "出社する日" = 初日 + 日数 business days in 本社

items.name: reason
items.text: 理由(reason) : long text "理由" count <=200 required when 種類 is 特別

items.name: cover
items.text: 代わり(cover) : person "代わりに対応する人" optional

items.name: submitted_by
items.text: submitted by everyone except team board

items.name: self_approval
items.text: self approval not allowed

items.name: same_approver
items.text: same approver approves once

items.name: send_back
items.text: send back to the requester, at most 2 times

items.name: comment_required
items.text: comment required for reject, send back

items.name: resubmit
items.text: resubmit within 5 business days

items.name: withdraw
items.text: withdraw until it is decided

items.name: hold_leave.take
items.text: on submitted hold 休暇.take(request: ticket.id, attempt: ticket.attempt, person: requester.id, days: 日数) when 種類 is 有給

items.name: post_leave.take
items.text: on approved post 休暇.take(request: ticket.id, attempt: ticket.attempt) when 種類 is 有給

items.name: void_leave.take
items.text: on sent back, rejected, withdrawn, expired void 休暇.take(request: ticket.id, attempt: ticket.attempt) when 種類 is 有給

items.name: 期限内に終わる
items.text: 期限内に終わる : every ticket ends within 40 business days

items.name: 長い有給休暇
